Weekly show.
The host invites aspiring dancers to showcase their dancing skills, while the mentors pick the best performers who compete to win the title.
Meenakshi belongs to a middle-class family, but her life drastically changes when she falls in love with Radha Krishna Vanamali, a rich businessman.
After losing her boyfriend in a riot, a grieving woman is forced into marriage with another man. Later, her world is shaken when she discovers she's pregnant with her late lover's child.
Ramulamma, a widow, is imprisoned after killing the murderers of her husband. Before leaving, she promises her daughter's hand in marriage to her nephew, but things take a turn in her absence.
